name: Simple Landing Page
prompt: A clean, modern landing page for a SaaS product. Include hero section with call-to-action, feature cards, testimonials, and footer. Use a calm blue color scheme.

name: Todo Application
prompt: A full-featured todo app with add, delete, complete, and filter functionality. Persist todos to localStorage. Use a minimal dark theme with purple accents.

name: Admin Dashboard
prompt: A responsive admin dashboard with sidebar navigation, main content area, and top bar. Include cards for stats, recent activity list, and user profile section. Use a professional dark theme.

name: Portfolio Site
prompt: A creative portfolio website for a designer. Include hero with name, about section, project grid, skills section, and contact form. Use a light theme with pastel colors.

name: Blog Layout
prompt: A clean blog layout with header, featured post, recent posts list, categories sidebar, and footer. Use a readable serif font for body text and a warm color palette.

name: Calculator App
prompt: A functional calculator with buttons for digits 0-9, operators (+, -, *, /, =), and clear button. Style it like a classic calculator with dark buttons and orange operators. Make it fully responsive.

name: Weather App UI
prompt: A weather application UI with current conditions, 5-day forecast, and hourly weather. Use weather icons (emoji or SVG), temperature display, and a search bar. Use a gradient background based on weather conditions.

name: E-commerce Product Page
prompt: An e-commerce product detail page with image gallery, product info (name, price, description), add to cart button, and related products section. Use a clean white background with subtle shadows.

name: Chat Interface
prompt: A modern chat interface with message list, input area, and send button. Messages should have avatars, timestamps, and be styled with speech bubbles. Use a light background with dark text.

name: Form with Validation
prompt: A registration form with fields for name, email, password, and confirm password. Include client-side validation with error messages. Use a clean card layout with focus states.
